project_tracker_diagnostic: Open, branching white aster with many small heads, often dark wiry stems, and thin serrate leaves that narrow to short petioles.

project_inclusion.learning_reason: Common or useful Central Texas fall/white composite for field learning.

morphology_keys.habit: Branching herb, often airy and open in woodland edges and shade.
morphology_keys.leaves: Alternate; lower/mid leaves ovate to deltoid or elliptic with serrate margins; upper leaves smaller.
morphology_keys.heads: Many small heads with white rays and yellow disks aging pinkish to purplish.
morphology_keys.phyllaries: Several series, narrow, green, appressed to somewhat spreading.
morphology_keys.fruit: Cypselae with a pappus of bristles.

photo_strategy.selection_logic: Prefer curated taxon photos plus multiple views from one Central Texas/Texas observation.
